bleed.name: bleed
bleed.desc:
Open wounds weep with every heartbeat.

Each wound bleeds on its own for a few turns. Armour does nothing to stem it.

Wounds: %1$d
Damage per turn: %2$d
Turns until the last wound closes: %3$d

burn.desc:
Flame clings to flesh and cloth alike.

Burning deals fire damage every turn. A fresh flame renews it rather than adding to it; water puts it out, and it may set dry ground alight.

Turns of burning remaining: %s.

chill.desc:
A deep cold slows every movement.

A chilled character takes 30%% longer for every action. Being chilled three times within a few turns freezes it solid for a turn.

Turns of chill remaining: %s.
chill.countDesc:
Frost gathers on this character.

Chill applications so far: %1$d of %2$d. Reaching %2$d within %3$d turns freezes it for a turn.
chill.freezeDesc:
Encased in ice.

A frozen character loses its next action. Any damage shatters the ice at once.

Turns of freeze remaining: %s.

shock.name: shock
shock.desc:
Stray charge crackles beneath the skin, leaving the body raw to every blow.

Shocks: %1$d
Extra damage taken: %2$d%%
Turns remaining: %3$s

blight.name: blight
blight.desc:
A creeping rot spreads through the blood.

Each dose of blight deals damage every turn, and while any remains all healing received is halved.

Doses: %1$d
Damage per turn: %2$d
Turns until the last dose fades: %3$d

stun.desc:
Senses reel and limbs refuse to answer.

A stunned character loses its next action.

Turns remaining: %s.

fear.desc:
Blind panic drives this character away from what it fears.

Only a single blow worth more than a fifth of its Life shocks it out of the terror.

Turns of fear remaining: %s.

hero.name: dread
hero.desc:
A cold dread grips your sword arm.

While it lasts you cannot strike a blow or loose a harmful skill; you can still move, drink, light a candle or use a skill that harms no one. A single blow worth more than a fifth of your Life breaks it.

Turns of dread remaining: %s.
hero.refused: Dread holds your hand: you cannot strike now.

slow.desc:
Time drags thick around this character.

A slowed character takes half again as long for every action.

Turns of slow remaining: %s.

weaken.desc:
A sapping weariness settles into the limbs.

A weakened character deals a quarter less damage with every attack, spell and lingering wound it causes.

Turns of weakness remaining: %s.

vulnerable.desc:
Every defence feels paper-thin.

A vulnerable character takes a fifth more damage from every source.

Turns of vulnerability remaining: %s.

blind.desc:
The world dissolves into a dark haze.

A blinded character sees only the tiles beside it, and its attacks find their mark half as often.

Turns of blindness remaining: %s.

ccImmunity.name: unbowed
ccImmunity.desc:
This foe has just shaken off a stun, freeze, fear or root, and will not be held again so soon.

Turns remaining: %s.

healOverTime.name: mending
healOverTime.desc:
Wounds knit slowly closed.

Life restored per turn: %1$d
Turns remaining: %2$d

taunted.name: taunted
taunted.desc:
Goaded beyond reason, this foe can only attack the one who provoked it.

Turns remaining: %s.

toll.label: Toll
toll.warn: The drowned bell shudders on its rope. Reach a lit candle before it speaks!
toll.rings: The bell tolls! Its voice rolls through the flooded nave like a winter storm.
toll.spared: The candlelight holds the bell's voice at bay.
toll.gutter: The bell's breath gutters the candle that sheltered you.
toll.vigil: Your vigil holds: the dread finds no purchase in you.

tide.label: Tide
tide.rising: The water stirs along the marked aisle...
tide.flood: Black water wells up from below: the aisle drowns.

fight.start: Something kneeling at the altar lifts its head. Under the pews the water begins to stir.

deep.desc: Deep water, black and cold. Wading through it slows you; no fire catches here and no snare holds.

candle.name: candle stand
candle.desc_lit: An iron pricket stand on a stone plinth, its thick candle burning. While it burns, its light shelters the squares around it from the bell.
candle.desc_out: An iron pricket stand on a stone plinth. Its candle has gone out and a thread of smoke curls from the wick. Tend it, or put fire to it, to light it again.
candle.relit: You shield the wick and coax the candle alight.
candle.relit_fire: The flames catch the wick: the candle burns again.

tile.pew_desc: A long oak pew, swollen with damp. The water has never risen over it.
tile.dais_desc: Pale flagstones raised above the flood, worn smooth by kneeling.
tile.bell_desc: A great bronze bell lies cracked on its flank where it fell from the tower, green with the years.
